items.question: Is the library really free?
items.answer: Yes. Every guide, prompt and template is free. You sign up once so we can send you new workflows as they go live.

items.question: What do I get after signing up?
items.answer: Instant access to every workflow from Outskill's videos, plus the directory of AI tools sorted by what they do and what they cost.

items.question: How often are new workflows added?
items.answer: Every week. Each new Outskill breakdown on YouTube gets its own guide.

items.question: Do I need to know how to code?
items.answer: No. Most guides need no code at all, and the ones that do walk you through every command.
